payload.artist_html: F. Irazoqui, C. A. Hospitaleche, A. Paulina-Carabajal, P. Bona & N. Vega
payload.credit_html: "New Species of Vegavis (Neornithes) from Antarctica Highlights Unexpected Cretaceous Antarctic Diversity"
payload.description_html: Virtual reconstruction of posterior cervical vertebra of Vegavis geitononesos (MLP-PV 15-I-7-52). Vertebra in (a) rostral, (b) caudal, (c) left lateral, (d) right lateral, (e) dorsal and (f) ventral views. Abbreviations: an, ansa costotransversaria; facd, facies articularis caudalis; fcr, facies articularis rostralis; focr, fossae cranialis; ftr, fenestrae transversaria; pco, processus costalis; ps, processus spinosus; pvc, processus ventralis corporis; td, torus dorsalis; zcd; zygapophysis caudalis. Scale bar = 10 mm.
